# Hermes Proactive Agent (`proactive-agent`)

> Hermes Agent plugin that makes the chat agent a responsive assistant that manages subagents: a soft/hard turn budget for the main agent, background detach for long commands, a handoff contract for delegate_task (user memory and a chat summary attached automatically), fail-fast and safety guards for subagents, result checks and progress updates.

## Overview

- Repository: https://github.com/JerryLiu369/hermes-proactive-agent
- Target: Hermes Agent (tested with v0.22.7)
- Language: Python 3.10+
- License: MIT
- Version: 0.1.9

Roles:
- Main agent ("secretary"): keeps the chat responsive, investigates and decides, owns the conversation.
- Subagents ("workers"): do slow execution with a complete brief, under supervision.

## Capabilities

### Secretary turn budget
- Yellow zone (default 60 s or 30,000 chars of tool output in one turn): a one-time reminder to answer or delegate within 1-2 steps.
- Red zone (default 120 s or 80,000 chars): editing and execution tools are refused; read-only tools and delegate_task remain.
- A mid-turn user message (steer) resets the budget.
- Foreground terminal commands longer than 30 s move to the background via Hermes' yield path and notify on completion.
- process_manage(action='wait'), unbounded recursive searches over home, / or ~/.hermes, and port scans are refused.

### Handoff contract (delegate_task)
- A brief with context under 120 characters, or a risky task without a rollback path, is returned once per turn with a checklist.
- Accepted tasks get: a conversation summary (auxiliary model via ctx.llm, 12 s timeout, plain-extract fallback), USER.md and MEMORY.md, working rules, and a default output_schema (status, summary, evidence, blockers, files_changed).

### Worker guards
- Same call with the same result, or the same failure, 3 times: the worker is stopped and must report "blocked".
- Step budget: 40 tool rounds (warning at 80%).
- Risky commands (SSH/firewall, HTTP DELETE, rm -rf on system/home paths, cloud delete/terminate, reboot) refused without a rollback path in the handoff.
- write_file/patch refused on files changed by someone else after the worker started, until re-read.

### Results, pivots, progress
- When a worker returns, the secretary's next turn lists the reported evidence or warns about missing evidence / a plugin stop.
- Running workers are listed each turn; a new task on the same targets as a running worker asks once to stop the old one.
- Progress lines every 5 minutes and stuck alerts are posted to the chat via ctx.post_message.

Only platforms in governed_platforms (default ["weixin"]) are affected. Cron runs and subagents of ungoverned sessions are untouched.

## Configuration

Keys under plugins.entries.proactive-agent.settings (environment override: PROACTIVE_<KEY>):

| Key | Default |
|---|---|
| governed_platforms | ["weixin"] |
| terminal_auto_detach_seconds | 30 |
| turn_soft_seconds | 60 |
| turn_hard_seconds | 120 |
| turn_soft_output_chars | 30000 |
| turn_hard_output_chars | 80000 |
| handoff_min_context_chars | 120 |
| handoff_summary_enabled | true |
| handoff_summary_timeout_seconds | 12 |
| handoff_memory_max_chars | 4000 |
| worker_max_tool_rounds | 40 |
| worker_repeat_limit | 3 |
| worker_guard_risky_commands | true |
| worker_write_guard | true |
| verify_child_results | true |
| progress_push_enabled | true |
| progress_interval_seconds | 300 |

## Install

```bash
hermes plugins install github:JerryLiu369/hermes-proactive-agent
hermes plugins enable proactive-agent
```
